items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: But with Lonnie, Lonnie, we didn't have a regular job. But we played in Philadelphia also. But we played there one night, there one night, you know, like we called it gigs.

ctx.x: What kind of music were you playing?
Well that was similar to Charlie, Charlie Miller, similar. Only Lonnie played a little bit more jazz. See, Lonnie -
You mean, Lonnie as an individual played more jazz than Charlie Miller -
